metadata.source: Sakay.ph GTFS (LTFRB PUJ routes, City of Manila + Mandaluyong City)
metadata.source_route_vintage: feed service dates ended 2020; routes should be verified against current sources
metadata.purpose: Replacement for v1 (PARA PH-derived) dataset — real named stops as graph nodes instead of raw polyline coordinates, per project methodology rules
metadata.route_geometry_status: No polyline geometry in this source; edges are straight-line (haversine) distances between consecutive real stops, NOT road-following distances. This underestimates real travel distance, especially around curves/turns.
metadata.direction_status: Each route's stop_ids_in_area order reflects real GTFS travel sequence (spot-verified: consecutive gaps 89-338m, consistent with real stop spacing, not an arbitrary sort). Edges are directed only, matching listed order -- no assumed reverse direction.
metadata.coverage_status: Only 181 of 659 available routes are included -- routes fully contained within the City of Manila + Mandaluyong City boundary. The other 478 routes have stops filtered out by the boundary, making list-order adjacency unverifiable without a different method; they are NOT included here and are not silently dropped without this note.

assumptions.note: Reused from v1 for methodological consistency, not independently re-derived for this source.
